topic: compass/invariant — CLI and module scanner behaviour must stay aligned
decision: bin/commands/compass.js (CLI) and modules/compass/sources/index.ts (programmatic API) implement the same scanner logic in two places. Any change to one must be ported to the other in the same PR. A future refactor should unify them into a shared module.
key_insight: CLI and programmatic Compass share no source — they diverge silently. Every scanner change must be applied to both, or the duplication consolidated.
alternatives_considered: Accept divergence and document the split
Immediately consolidate into a shared module
rejected_reason: Accepting divergence is how PR #32 happened — the CLI was fixed in PR #31 but the module was not updated
Immediate consolidation is the right long-term fix but requires a larger refactor than the current PRs scope
